Priya N: Heads-up: PR #441 contains the migration guide updates + JS SDK snippet. Netlify preview shows two issues: an internal anchor broken (#sdk-initialization) and a missing /favicon.ico. Planning to merge in Wed maintenance 2026-04-08 01:30 UTC unless blockers. Can reviewers + infra sanity-check preview?

netlify-bot: [auto] Deploy queued for PR #441 63; preview: https://deploy-preview-441--redwood-docs.netlify.app 63; status: failed (2 checks) - missing asset /favicon.ico, linkcheck failed for internal anchor.

docs-ci-bot: CI results: md-lint: pass; linkcheck: 1 broken internal anchor (line ~72 of migration.md); snippet tests: basic smoke (OK).

Marco R: I can review. Quick ask 0: can you paste the preview link here? I want to check the anchor behavior (sometimes mkdocs plugin slugify differs).

Priya N: Link above; anchor appears as `#sdk-init` in generated HTML but markdown header is `### SDK initialization` with an explicit anchor in the old docs `#sdk-initialization` which explains mismatch. I missed updating the cross-link.

Sam T: Local repro steps that usually catch this:
```
git checkout pr/441
pipenv install --dev
mkdocs build
python -m http.server --directory site 8000
# then open http://localhost:8000/migration.html and check anchors
```
If slug differences are the problem, add an explicit anchor or update the link to the generated slug. Also check mkdocs plugins that affect header slugging.

Ivy K: For the favicon, Netlify serves from the site root. Put `favicon.ico` in `docs/` (or ensure `extra` in mkdocs.yml copies it) and reference it as `/favicon.ico`. PR #350 had similar fix.

Priya N: Pushed `fix/anchors-and-favicon` with two changes: updated cross-link to `#sdk-init` and copied favicon to `docs/`. Redeploying.

netlify-bot: [auto] Redeploy started (build id 88ef) for branch fix/anchors-and-favicon.

netlify-bot: [auto] Deploy finished 63; preview: https://deploy-preview-441--redwood-docs.netlify.app 63; status: success. linkcheck: pass; asset checks: favicon present.

Marco R: Reviewing now. Left a tiny nit to make the SDK snippet return the client instance so it's copy/paste friendly.

Sam T: Added a short local-checklist comment on the PR for future authors: 1) run `mkdocs build` + serve static output, 2) confirm generated anchor slugs if linking between pages, 3) ensure static assets (favicon, fonts) are in `docs/` or copied by mkdocs, 4) run linkcheck locally with `markdown-link-check`.

Marco R: Approved. :white_check_mark: The nit is optional.

Priya N: Great, scheduling merge for 2026-04-08 01:30 UTC maintenance slot. I'll add release note: "docs: fix internal anchor and favicon path in migration guide" and merge in window. Will ping infra if merging early. Closing thread after merge.
